```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(here)

census_dir <- here("data", "census")

dir.create(
  census_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

### Nationwide County-Level Socioeconomic data

```{r nationwide_county_data}

national_counties <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",

  variables = c(
    median_income = "B19013_001",
    population = "B01003_001",
    poverty_total = "B17001_001",
    poverty_count = "B17001_002",

    education_total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),

  year = 2024,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
)

national_counties <- national_counties %>%
  mutate(
    state_fips = str_sub(GEOID, 1, 2),

    poverty_rate = if_else(
      poverty_totalE > 0,
      poverty_countE / poverty_totalE * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),

    bachelors_or_higher = if_else(
      education_totalE > 0,
      (
        bachelorsE +
        mastersE +
        professionalE +
        doctorateE
      ) / education_totalE * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

dim(national_counties)

head(national_counties)

# Exclude Puerto Rico to match the city-level dataset
national_counties <- national_counties %>%
  filter(state_fips != "72")

# Verify county counts
nrow(national_counties)

# Verify 50 states + Washington, DC
n_distinct(national_counties$state_fips)
```

```{r county_validation}
county_validation <- national_counties %>%
  summarise(
    total_counties = n(),

    states_and_dc = n_distinct(state_fips),

    duplicate_geoids = sum(
      duplicated(GEOID)
    ),

    missing_income = sum(
      is.na(median_incomeE)
    ),

    missing_population = sum(
      is.na(populationE)
    ),

    missing_education = sum(
      is.na(bachelors_or_higher)
    ),

    invalid_poverty = sum(
      poverty_rate < 0 | poverty_rate > 100,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    invalid_education = sum(
      bachelors_or_higher < 0 |
      bachelors_or_higher > 100,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

county_validation
```

```{r county_boundaries}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Download 2024 county boundaries nationwide
county_boundaries <- tigris::counties(
  year = 2024,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep the same geographic scope as our Census data
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  filter(
    GEOID %in% national_counties$GEOID
  )

# Inspect the geographic data
dim(county_boundaries)

names(county_boundaries)

head(county_boundaries)
```

```{r missing_county}
national_counties %>%
  filter(is.na(median_incomeE)) %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, populationE)
```

```{r county_geographic reference}
# Convert land area from square meters to square miles
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  mutate(
    land_area_sqmi = as.numeric(ALAND) / 2589988.110336
  )

# Project boundaries before generating representative points
county_projected <- st_transform(
  county_boundaries,
  crs = 6933
)

# Generate a point inside each county
county_points <- st_point_on_surface(
  county_projected
)

# Convert points to latitude and longitude
county_points <- st_transform(
  county_points,
  crs = 4326
)

# Extract coordinates
county_coords <- st_coordinates(county_points)

county_points$longitude <- county_coords[, "X"]
county_points$latitude <- county_coords[, "Y"]

# Create a geographic lookup table
county_geography <- county_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    GEOID,
    land_area_sqmi,
    longitude,
    latitude
  )

head(county_geography)
```
```{r geographic_data_merge}

national_counties_geo <- national_counties %>%
  left_join(
    county_geography,
    by = "GEOID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    population_density = if_else(
      land_area_sqmi > 0,
      populationE / land_area_sqmi,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

dim(national_counties_geo)

head(
  national_counties_geo %>%
    select(
      GEOID,
      NAME,
      populationE,
      land_area_sqmi,
      population_density,
      latitude,
      longitude
    )
)
```

```{r validate_merge}
county_geo_validation <- national_counties_geo %>%
  summarise(
    total_counties = n(),
    missing_coordinates = sum(
      is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude)
    ),
    missing_land_area = sum(is.na(land_area_sqmi)),
    missing_density = sum(is.na(population_density)),
    duplicate_geoids = sum(duplicated(GEOID))
  )

county_geo_validation

nrow(national_counties)
nrow(national_counties_geo)
```

```{r save_county_data}

write_csv(
  national_counties_geo,
  file.path(census_dir, "national_counties_geo_2024.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  national_counties_geo,
  file.path(census_dir, "national_counties_geo_2024.rds")
)

write_csv(
  county_validation,
  file.path(census_dir, "county_validation_2024.csv")
)

write_csv(
  county_geo_validation,
  file.path(census_dir, "county_geo_validation_2024.csv")
)
```
